name: labs/aaronslaff__tecan_sparkcontrol
title: Tecan SparkControl microplate reader (spark_control_automation.SparkControlClient)
intro: Tecan SparkControl microplate reader (spark_control_automation.SparkControlClient), adapted from aaronslaff/tecan_sparkcontrol. It reads `instrument_status`, `available_apps`, `instrument_settings`, `plate_geometry` and 2 more; runs `calibrate`, `start_method`, `stop_method` and `stop_active_method`. `calibrate`: run the native calibration procedure for a calibration type. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
